items.reason: Needs network: pinning requires resolving each tag to its commit SHA via the GitHub API, and scripts/actions-pin.mjs --update (which also flips STRICT and raises the P6 ratchet in the same pass) cannot run without it; Dependabot's github-actions ecosystem is already configured to keep pins fresh.

Already closed by scripts/gate-timings.mjs: CI runs `npm run check:ci:timed` (ci.yml) instead of check:ci, which times every stage parsed out of the one declared chain, writes them to .gate-timings.json and the job summary, and fails when a seconds-gate runs after a slow one or when a stage labelled "seconds" in scripts/gate-remedy.mjs measures slower than that.

Already closed by scripts/harness-degradation.mjs: agent-review.yml calls --announce on BOTH sides of its keyless branch (::warning + job-summary line + a row in harness-status.json kept 90 days), the weekly history job runs --drill, and test-unit/harness-degradation.test.mjs executes --drill and --check inside test:unit so the drill is blocking rather than remembered.

Needs a test runner: a mutation score is a measurement, and this session can read and write files but cannot execute node (only `node -v` is permitted), so no harness could be run once, no score observed, and no honest failing floor set; added test-unit/cron-auth.test.mjs for the untested cron guard, which is the seam that most needed it, but the item's gap (a measured score with a threshold that fails) is still open.

Needs deploy access: the artefact asked for is a REHEARSED rollback with its timing and outcome, which requires a Vercel deployment, a real previous commit to roll back to and provider state to inspect; a runbook written offline would be documentation saying it should be done, not a drill record.

lessons: This repository already answers most maturity gaps with an executable gate rather than prose, so verify before building: check package.json's script list and .github/workflows first — `check:ci:timed`, `harness:drill` and `actions:pin` existed before the items that asked for them, and the honest work was confirming they operate, not re-adding them.

A gate here is only real when something runs it: harness:degradation:check is absent from the check:ci chain and is nonetheless blocking, because test-unit/harness-degradation.test.mjs shells out to --check and --drill inside test:unit. Grep for the script name across tests as well as workflows before calling a capability unenforced.

Autopilot sessions in this repo get file access but no command execution, so any item whose artefact is a MEASUREMENT (mutation score, gate timing baseline, rollback drill, an action digest) is structurally unclosable here and should be skipped with the exact command a human should run.
